title: 2027 IEEE Statistical Signal Processing Workshop (SSP)
about: Call for papers for the 2027 IEEE Statistical Signal Processing Workshop (SSP), held in Annecy, France, 28 June to 1 July 2027. Paper submissions are due 7 February 2027; full details are on the official workshop website.
